# =============================================================================
# Public-Repo Path Allowlist
# =============================================================================
# Positive list of paths that ARE allowed in the public repo. Any tracked file
# whose path is NOT matched by a pattern below will be REJECTED by CI
# (.github/workflows/path-allowlist.yml) and by the local pre-commit hook.
#
# Pattern syntax: gitignore-style globs.
#   - `**` matches any depth.
#   - Trailing `/**` matches everything under a directory recursively.
#   - Leading `!` negates (use to carve internal subdirs out of a wildcard).
#
# IMPORTANT — adding a new public-facing path?
#   1. Add a pattern below in the SAME PR that introduces it.
#   2. Reviewers should ask: is this path actually needed by users to install
#      or run Tsushin? If it's internal QA, audit, evidence, planning, or
#      developer-only material, it does NOT belong here — keep it under
#      `.private/` instead.
#
# This is the ONLY mechanism that keeps internal files out of the public repo.
# Don't weaken it.
# =============================================================================

# --- Top-level config & docs (the user-facing landing surface) ---
.gitignore
.gitleaks.toml
.pre-commit-config.yaml
LICENSE
README.md
CHANGELOG.md
CONTRIBUTING.md
DOCKER.md
DOCUMENTATION.md
USER_GUIDE.md
docker-compose.yml
docker-compose.ssl.yml
env.example
env.docker.example
install.py
backup_installer.py
deploy-to-vm.sh
platform_utils.py

# --- Source code subtrees (carve out dev/internal directories) ---
backend/**
!backend/dev_tests/**
!backend/ops/create_test_users.py
!backend/**/.private/**

frontend/**
!frontend/**/.private/**

caddy/**
proxy/**
k8s/**
ops/**
images/**

# --- Public-facing documentation only (everything in docs/ is reviewed) ---
docs/README.md
docs/changelog.md
docs/contributing.md
docs/docker.md
docs/documentation.md
docs/openapi.json
docs/upgrading-to-postgres.md
docs/user-guide.md
# Note: docs/qa/, docs/internal/, docs/archive/qa_evidence/ are NOT allowed.
# Internal QA/audit/evidence belongs under .private/, not docs/.

# --- GitHub config (workflows, ISSUE_TEMPLATE, allowlist itself, etc.) ---
.github/**
